question: The ‘Mukteshwar’ dance festival is held from 14th to 16th January at the Mukteshwar temple in the state of ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The 'Mukteshwar' dance festival is celebrated from **14th to 16th January** every year.
 
• It is held at the **Mukteshwar Temple**, which is an important heritage site.
 
• This festival is a significant cultural event in the state of **Odisha**.
 
• The festival features performances by reno
